IND-NY.summary: 2024 East semifinals: Pacers coach Rick Carlisle was fined $35,000 for criticizing the officiating after Game 2, arguing small-market teams were not getting a fair whistle against the Knicks.

2024 East semifinals, Game 5: Donte DiVincenzo and Myles Turner scuffled and both received technicals. Isaiah Jackson, Alec Burks and Isaiah Hartenstein also got technicals in a separate flare-up. DiVincenzo said afterward the Pacers were trying to act like tough guys.
2025 East finals, Game 1: Tyrese Haliburton copied Reggie Miller's choke celebration after a game-tying shot that forced overtime, reviving a symbol of the rivalry.
